blurb: Admire one of the West’s most dramatic natural landscapes—and explore beyond Portland with ease—on this small-group day trip to Mount St. Helens National Volcanic Monument. With your naturalist guide leading the way, walk through the park and uncover its volcanic history, including the powerful 1980 eruption. Transportation, along with a picnic lunch, snacks, and beverages throughout the day, is all provided for your convenience.
